document.abstract: This standard defines the structure of a dictionary of types for all registers defined by SMPTE ST 336. These types may be used in a range of applications such as production workflow applications, data exchange formats, and archival asset management systems. — The standard normatively defines universal identifiers, type names, definitions, and standardized symbols, as well as other normative and informative fields. — Applications of individual entries will vary, but, when used, shall conform to the definitions and formats in the types dictionary.
